description: The bar chart is titled "A runtime comparison between our ensemble model and various LLM models on the SEconvo dataset." The chart compares the runtime of different models, specifically the Joint Framework and the Dual-LLM Framework. The x-axis represents the models, with the Joint Framework on the left and the Dual-LLM Framework on the right. The y-axis represents the runtime in seconds, with the Joint Framework having a runtime of 77 seconds and the Dual-LLM Framework having a runtime of 172 seconds. The chart shows that the Joint Framework has a significantly lower runtime compared to the Dual-LLM Framework.
